title: Creation of a comprehensive repeat library for a newly sequenced parasitic worm genome
protocol: Build a repeat library for the newly sequenced genome using RepeatModeler.
Build a second repeat library for the newly sequenced genome using TransposonPSI.
Remove sequences shorter than 50 bp from the TransposonPSI repeat library.
Build a third repeat library for the newly sequenced genome using LTRharvest to identify long terminal repeat retrotransposons.
Run LTRdigest on the LTRharvest results, with protein HMMs from Pfam and GyDB.
Remove any LTR retrotransposon candidates without domain hits.
Classify repeats in each of the three repeat libraries using RepeatClassifier.
Merge the repeat libraries from RepeatModeler, TransposonPSI, and LTRharvest using USEARCH v7 to cluster candidate sequences with ≥80% identity.
Remove all but one sequence for each cluster to create a non-redundant library.
Filter the non-redundant library by removing repeats classified as ‘unknown’ by RepeatClassifier.
Exclude repeats that have BLASTN hits of E≤0.001 against known protein-coding genes and ncRNA genes from nematodes and platyhelminths.
Use the filtered non-redundant library to mask repeats in the genome using RepeatMasker with the –s (sensitive) option.
